data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 豪农深宅紫阳花径的雨后漫步·「你看，这一片是我亲手种下的呢」
data.description: 【千反田家大宅紫阳花回廊·雨后初晴】雨过天晴的日式庭院。爱瑠穿着素雅的浅紫无袖连衣裙，提着淡紫色裙摆漫步在水珠晶莹的蓝色与紫色绣球花海中。她侧头回眸伸手接住从花瓣滑落的雨滴，神情自豪又带着大小姐对这片土地的深沉眷恋。
data.location: 日式深宅庭院紫阳花石子径
data.action: 一手微提淡紫裙摆停在花径，另一手接住花瓣滑落的雨滴，回眸浅笑。
data.lighting: 雨洗碧空的明净天光与花瓣雨露折射
data.camera: medium full shot, hydrangeas, traditional garden, looking back
data.promptProse: Eru Chitanda lifts the edge of her lavender maxi dress while walking among wet blue and purple hydrangeas at the family garden corridor. A white cardigan rests over her forearms as she turns back and catches a falling petal droplet with one hand. The medium-full view follows the planted beds toward the wooden veranda. Clear after-rain daylight lights the wet flowers and dress pintucks, with bright water beads above softer leaf shadows.
